description: Virtual staging: furnish and decorate an empty or bare room from a photo in a chosen style, for a new home, a rental or a listing. Uses one House AI design credit.

notes.description: Anything specific the user asked for, in their words (for example 'keep the fireplace').
notes.title: Notes

photo.description: The room or house photo the user attached in chat. Filled in by the app, not typed.

photo_upload_id.description: The upload_id from get_photo_upload_link, once the user says the photo is uploaded.
photo_upload_id.title: Photo Upload Id

photo_url.description: A public https link to the photo, if the user gave one instead of attaching it.
photo_url.title: Photo Url

style.description: Design style, for example 'Japandi' or 'mid-century modern'.
style.title: Style

name: furnish_empty_room
title: Furnish an empty room
